claim: sensor with an item or liquid name is the normal inventory read (vault + @copper -> 100, an item the container does not hold -> 0, a non-container -> null). It is correct code and must never be reported as sensor-not-a-property.
why: Measured on v160.7 (out/takeover-20261024/15-sensor-link-oracle.md). This rule exists only to stop the tempting generalisation 'a non-LAccess @name in sensor is a bug'; item and liquid reads are how the game exposes stock.
